before.lore: Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.

before.lore: Every stride leaves a footstep of violet, trailing your path. The flower buds peek out of the ground as if nervous, and after a moment's hesitation, burgeon -- blooming hysteria into the hearts of man.

after.lore: Every stride leaves a footstep of violet, trailing your path. The flower buds peek out of the ground as if nervous, and after a moment's hesitation, burgeon -- blooming hysteria into the hearts of man.

majorIds.Solar Wind: Thunderstorm disables Meteor, grants +3 thunderbolts, +3 radius and deals 100% and 110% each. Unstable now activates on Thunderstorm for 400% bonus damage.

before.lore: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.

majorIds.Solar Wind: Thunderstorm disables Meteor, grants +2 mana bank per hit, +2 thunderbolts, +3 radius, and deals 130% and 150% each. Unstable now activates on Thunderstorm for 300% bonus damage.

after.lore: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.

before.lore: Sleek black plates, harder than steel, tougher than granite. Threads of ancient magick weave themselves through the material, granting you all the power of the dark stone.

majorIds.Strings of Fate: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.

before.lore: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.

majorIds.Dauntless Inferno: Courage casts a series of 5 infernos that expand after the last, dealing 150% each, and grants 20% resistance instead of a damage boost.

before.lore: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.

majorIds.Dauntless Inferno: Courage casts a series of 5 infernos that expand after the last, dealing 150% each, and grants 25% resistance instead of a damage boost.

after.lore: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.

before.lore: The Expanse holds an exigent paranoia, a hamartia for even the most renowned heroes. Only a survivor knows to hoard intelligence, showing their hand only when none will be left to recount it.

majorIds.Fissure: Ice Snake moves much more slowly, but deals massive knockback, +275%, and +155%.

before.lore: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.

majorIds.Fissure: Ice Snake moves much more slowly, but deals massive knockback, +350%, and +200%.

after.lore: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.

majorIds.Brachiate: Grappling Hook has 25% increased range and increased velocity.

before.lore: King of the Jungle-it's a title reserved for the apex of the apex, and yet from where you swing across the canopy, this beast of supposed royalty is but another victim of your thievish pursuits.

majorIds.Brachiate: Grappling Hook has 50% increased range and increased velocity.

after.lore: King of the Jungle-it's a title reserved for the apex of the apex, and yet from where you swing across the canopy, this beast of supposed royalty is but another victim of your thievish pursuits.

majorIds.Alter Ego: Awakened can be activated after saving 40% less mana, but its duration is reduced by 25%.

before.lore: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.

majorIds.Alter Ego: Mantra will overload Masks 150% faster, but also decay them 100% faster.

after.lore: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.

add.lore: The universe loves you. It loves you so much that its heart bleeds for you, into your hands and leaking between your fingers. You can't hold onto it; can't say back the words that mean so much to you, for there is nobody there to hear them.

majorIds.Solar Fracture: Hand of the Shaman gains +2 beams.

add.lore: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.

majorIds.Juggle: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by -8% and -2%, and Finality's damage scaling is halved.

add.lore: "What's yours is mine, and what's mine is yours, so emptying those bloated coffers is of little loss to you, no?"

majorIds.Astrobleme: Final Crush further delays Bash's last hit, but increases its radius by an additional +50%.

add.lore: Humanity's strength is naught but rubbish next to the heights of its predecessors.

The notorious and erratic magical inventor Gawrick once attempted to make teleportation scrolls obsolete, by creating items which would allow the user to phase into an ethereal state to move unhindered. He did not account for the physical ramifications of this process, however.

majorIds.Chain Reaction: Basaltic Traps arm faster and detonate immediately after arming, gaining +2 range.

add.lore: When it feels like anything could set you off, prepare to go out with a bang!
Life is mere sand in a shrinking hourglass, slipping between drowsy fingers until the sweet lull of sleep turns sickening. And yet you sink again; into slumber, into nothing. The sand still falls...
Over countless decades, through the rotting of wood and the rust of iron, the flames woven into this heirloom burn as white-hot as the day they were woven; anticipating something to ignite

majorIds.Phase Vector: Shocking Bomb and Arrow Storm become lightning fast with reduced spread.

add.lore: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.
